answer: A credible defense is a refundable stake bond: before an agent can trade, it locks a meaningful deposit in a shared vault, so creating thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of deposits. Like an opal that is costly to cut and easy to verify, one verified reputation is cheap to check but expensive to fake at scale. Honest agents earn the bond back over time, while a terrace of Sybil accounts collapses under its own collateral cost, because the attacker pays per identity while the network verifies them almost for free.
